auxiliary_identity_codec: Join node_identity USING(node_id) to access the same loader-only iri as Neo4j. Source IRI containing RANx is not the loader iri; the latter uses /inst/_/{cls}/{nid}. This is stable entity identity, not a source-authored property. Business identifier fields remain their original values.
join_convention: For each relationship_direction table, pairs are [source label table,destination label table]. Join source.node_id=relationship.src_id and destination.node_id=relationship.dst_id. All node/label tables share node_id. Use exactly the SQL table names in DDL, including rel_ prefixes; graph relationship names without rel_ are not SQL tables.
value_codec: STRICT ANY columns preserve native string/integer/real storage. Booleans are 0/1; arrays/objects canonical JSON text. Absent properties are SQL NULL; node_property distinguishes stored null from absence. Nested JSON outputs use SQLite JSON functions. Private _ tables are inaccessible.
